Name: Dynamic Shader
Author: Nookick
Description:
[b]Dynamic Shader [early access][/b]
🫡Yes, we introduced a shader for Stardew Valley.
This mod replaces the simple vanilla shadows with a GPU-accelerated rendering system that simulates the sun's movement throughout the day (so far).
[b][img]https://i.ibb.co/39nW6b6d/fram.png[/img][/b]
[You can see that it even reflects the transparency of the glass]﻿

[b]⚠️ Note:[/b] This mod is currently in [b]Early Access[/b]. It may be unstable as we continue to develop the core rendering layer.

[b]✨ Features[/b][list]
[*][b][/b][b]Authentic Shadow Shape:[/b] Objects cast true-to-life shadows based on their geometry.
[*][b]Dynamic Shadows:[/b] Shadows evolve with time and weather conditions.
[*][b]Realistic Rendering[/b]:[list]
[*][b]Soft Edges[/b]: Shadows feature high-quality Gaussian blur for a natural, soft look.
[*][b]Gradient Fading[/b]: Shadows naturally fade out as they get further from the object.
[*][b]Shear Transformation[/b]: Uses proper geometric transformation instead of simple rotation for realistic perspective.
[/list]
[*][b]Performance Optimized[/b]: Built with a custom HLSL shader and GPU acceleration to ensure smooth performance even on large farms.
[/list]🛠️[b] Compatibility[/b][list]
[*][b]Stardew Valley 1.6[/b]
[*][b]Fashion Sense / Furniture Framework / Night Shader[/b]
[*]Compatible with most retexture mods.
[/list][b]📦 Installation[/b][list=1]
[*]Install the latest version of [url=vscode-file://vscode-app/e:/Software/IDE/VSCode/resources/app/out/vs/code/electron-browser/workbench/workbench.html]SMAPI[/url].
[*]Download this mod and unzip it into your [code]Stardew Valley/Mods[/code] folder.
[*]Run the game using SMAPI.
[/list]
🚀 Roadmap (What's Next)We are building a comprehensive graphics overhaul. Future updates will include:
[list]
[*] [b]Bloom[/b] (Glow effects)
[*] [b]Volumetric Fog[/b] simulation
[*] [b]Water Surface Reflections[/b]
[*] Further performance optimizations
[*] etc
[/list]
